trigger.description: The scale envelope observes cache, WAL, or index churn that exceeds ordinary command SLO assumptions. The response must surface the posture instead of treating slow command observations as normal steady state.
trigger.invocation: Emit ee.scale_envelope.v1 with pageCacheWalPosture.cacheState=thrashing, walState=checkpoint_recommended, or commandSlos[].status=thrashing.

expected_emission.repair_string: Reduce concurrent pressure, checkpoint WAL if recommended, rebuild stale indexes, and retry the scale probe before trusting command SLOs.
